alt: HHS Office for Civil Rights (OCR) Complaint Form Confirmation receipt showing Receipt Number XXXX39.
summary: This document is the official confirmation and receipt from the HHS Office for Civil Rights (OCR) for the complaint filed against Palmdale Regional Medical Center. The filing was successfully submitted on June 21, 2026, under Receipt Number XXXX39, establishing an active federal investigation into the hospital's records amendment default.
full_text:
U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
Office for Civil Rights
Complaint Portal: Health Information Privacy, Security, & Breach Notification

Complaint Form Confirmation

Receipt Number: XXXX39

Thank you for contacting the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), Office for Civil Rights (OCR). OCR enforces federal civil rights laws which prohibit discrimination in the delivery of health and human services based on race, color, national origin, disability, age, sex, religion, and also enforces the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy, Security and Breach Notification Rules.

We are in the process of reviewing your correspondence. We will complete our initial review as quickly as possible.
